scope: synthetic engineering checks; thresholds are design defaults measured on one run
checks: a near-duplicate lesson reinforces the existing belief (evidence merged, history kept); a new lesson is added
a prompt shows every explicit belief and at most four inferred lessons: situation-related first, then the newest
over the byte budget, inferred interpretations (beliefs) are trimmed to two before any memory is cut
consolidation asks for lessons about people and events, not scripts of the agent's own conversational habits
the previous same-thread session shows the gist of the person's own words, even when sleep dropped those turns
a reused run of six words (three of them content words) counts as repeating oneself; ordinary new lines do not
a decision citing a belief or relationship-evidence id it was shown drops that id instead of costing a repair call; an id never shown is still rejected
consolidation may cite memories shown in its context as evidence; only the batch is marked consolidated
a caregiver link creates the adult's relationship to the child too, also when the adult is materialized later
